value.rationale: The number of possible three-gram histogram outputs under one source deletion is a natural local noise capacity for profile-based coding, and unlike raw deletion descendants it has a universal bound. Ten intrinsic interior error classes, four boundary classes, an unexpectedly delayed exact saturation at length 20, and explicit families for every larger length provide a complete natural sharp maximum-by-length classification. Neither the previously published length-two six-profile bound nor the global three-gram profile enumeration determines this invariant; it stands without a downstream code-rate theorem.
